decisions.reason: A low-cost accessory that complements the core trailer range and was consistently presented on its own page; it needs little slack and creates no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

Box trailers are a core segment and B was featured on the home page in both observed years, which suggests results at or above aspiration, so management would keep it while the trailer market stays strong.

Car transporters serve a niche of professional users and had less prominent placement, but the firm's production know-how and slack allow it to carry the product without evidence of a clear shortfall.
Low-bed trailers are a staple of the range and were featured prominently in both years, consistent with performance meeting aspirations.
High covers are a value-adding variant that uses existing production lines and was shown on the home page, so dropping it would gain little.
This second box trailer series may overlap with B, which gives a modest chance of consolidation, but its home-page prominence points to adequate results, so it is kept.
